etf/false.analystBriefing: Sample Co Ltd. (NIFTYBEES) is an exchange-traded fund that tracks Index & ETFs. Its price follows the underlying basket, so company-level ratios such as ROCE do not apply; the NV Score gives it a fixed quality of 75 and valuation of 60 and scores only its 12-month return rank.
catalyst: Holds many securities (or a commodity), so the results of one company move it less than a single stock.
risk: Returns follow the index or commodity it tracks, including its falls.
playbook: NV Score 60/100, set mostly by its 12-month return rank.
Tracking difference against its benchmark and the expense ratio (from the fund house factsheet).
Daily closing prices update the 12-month return rank.

holding/false.analystBriefing: Sample Co Ltd. (AAA) functions as an equity investment holding company. Standard operating ROCE and P/E ratios are mathematically distorted by holding company discounts and non-operating dividend income. Valuation must be assessed via Sum-of-the-Parts (SOTP) net asset value.
catalyst: Value realization is linked to the market capitalization growth of listed subsidiaries and unlisted associates.
risk: Holding company share prices often trade below the value of their underlying holdings; the gap varies by company and over time.
playbook: The 1-100 score is not calculated for this category because standard operating ratios do not apply.
Relevant metrics for this category: NAV discount (holding companies), EV / VNB (insurance), distribution yield (REITs / InvITs).
Market value of core subsidiary holdings and parent capital allocation track record.

insurance/false.analystBriefing: Sample Co Ltd. (AAA) operates an actuarial insurance underwriting portfolio. Statutory accounting and premium float dynamics make industrial ROCE metrics non-applicable; valuation is driven by Value of New Business (VNB) margins and Embedded Value (EV).
catalyst: Long-duration customer float and growing policyholder retention fuel actuarial book value expansion.
risk: Regulatory commission caps and sudden mortality/morbidity claims spikes can pressure quarterly margins.
playbook: The 1-100 score is not calculated for this category because standard operating ratios do not apply.
Relevant metrics for this category: NAV discount (holding companies), EV / VNB (insurance), distribution yield (REITs / InvITs).
VNB margins, persistency ratios, and solvency margin ratio.
